title: Book Coral at the Savannah | Rosemary Beach Vacation Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Coral at the Savannah is a stately second-floor Rosemary Beach vacation rental with 2 bedrooms and 2 baths. Click here to learn more and book a stay in this fantastic property!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This 2-bedroom, 2-bath property hosts six guests, making it the perfect place for a family vacation or an escape with friends. However, even if it’s just you and your small family, you just might decide to treat yourself after reading up on Coral at the Savannah!

The Interior

When you walk in, you’ll be immediately struck by the clean, modern theme that echoes through its halls. However, while modern and sleek, you can’t help but get the feeling you just walked into a sailor’s den with a beautiful painting on the wall that match the ocean’s blue in the distance. You can’t help but find yourself feeling lucky you got to stay here after the hard work and sweat that went into a fresh redecorating. As you explore, you’ll notice the 47” flat screen TV situated in one of the living rooms, and you can already see you and your family snuggled up on the couch watching a movie as the crickets begin to chirp outside. You take a quick glance in the kitchen and smile to yourself as you know that you are going to spend at least one evening amongst it’s counters as you create a feast.

You continue on and explore the master bathroom and almost wish it were nighttime so you could enjoy the king bed with its own private flat screen TV. The bathroom, you find, matches the rest of the home with its sleek modern flair and ocean colors. You eye the large soaking tub sitting next to the shower, already calling out to you to rest your weary muscles as warm water massages them. As you explore, you must admit the second bedroom is striking to the eyes, not to mention you can’t help but feel there is something fun about the bunk beds. You’re sure your kids will also love having some time to themselves, enjoying the flat screen TV that is situated in this room as well. Further, while it lacks the soaking tub, the shower and slated tiles really are inviting in their own unique way.

You finally come the second living area and, while it does lack a TV, you can’t help but feel this room would be perfect for you all to sit together and maybe even play a board game or two. As you walk onto the balcony and feel the warm Florida sun great you, you have to admit that it does have a lovely view of South and North Barret Square. You already can see you and your significant other sipping coffee as you watch the sunrise together.

The Amenities

While this description might be enough to invoke your curiosity, or possibly even cause a slight tug of longing in your heart, you will surely be impressed by the large range of amenities that are offered. Not only do you have several televisions, but you get access to a large selection of DVDs (the very act of renting a movie is sure to bring nostalgia to many!). Further, you will get complimentary Wi-Fi as well as two adult bicycles which are perfect for exploring the area. Not to mention, you get access to the gym and tennis courts, with the cherry on top being a washer and dryer in unit along with all the essentials you’ll need to get started ranging from paper towels to shampoo to garbage bags to cookware!

If this description at all piques your interest, make sure to call us at (866) 348-8952 or book this lovely property online for your trip!

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY
